LESSON: NAMING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.1: Naming
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Naming, part of Listening and Speaking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we use water at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify different places and ways of getting water,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Naming in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. mention different containers for storing water,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Naming in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. demonstrate awareness of uses of water in our daily lives,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Naming in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Naming together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner demonstrates hard work while role playing uses of water.

• Respect: The learner practises patience while taking turns in talking about sources of water.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Disaster Risk Reduction awareness: The learner is cautioned to keep off dangerous water sources for safety.

Link to other Activity Areas:

rain under elements of weather.
